data.body: Phase 2 of the user assignment. After Phase 1 is green and committed/pushed, audit all repo code outside v3/@hive-flow/cli that is not under a dot-prefixed folder, deduplicate/collapse it into the CLI folder/source as appropriate, rewire imports/scripts/installability, correct any residual deprecated naming conventions found along the way, and verify nothing breaks.
data.title: Collapse non-dot non-CLI repo code into v3/@hive-flow/cli
